description_en: Modifies an anti-ransomware backup policy for databases
description_zh: 修改数据库防勒索备份策略
name: ModifyUniBackupPolicy

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the anti-ransomware backup policy for databases.
You can call the [DescribeUniBackupPolicies](~~DescribeUniBackupPolicies~~) operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
数据库防勒索备份策略的ID。
调用[DescribeUniBackupPolicies](~~DescribeUniBackupPolicies~~)接口可以获取该参数
parameters.name: policy_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the anti-ransomware backup policy for databases
parameters.help_zh: 数据库防勒索备份策略的名称
parameters.name: policy_name

parameters.help_en: The number of days for which backup snapshots are retained
parameters.name: retention

parameters.help_en: The network bandwidth throttling for backup network bandwidth. Unit: bytes
parameters.help_zh: 备份网络带宽限制。单位为字节
parameters.name: speed_limiter

parameters.help_en: The username of the database account
parameters.name: account_name

parameters.help_en: The password of the database account
parameters.name: account_password

parameters.help_en:
The full backup policy. The value is in JSON format and contains the following fields:

start: the backup start time.
interval: the interval.
type: the unit of the interval.
days: the days of the week on which the backup is performed
parameters.help_zh:
全量备份策略。格式为JSON格式。包含以下字段：

start：备份开始时间
interval：间隔周期
type：间隔周期单位
days：周中执行日期
parameters.name: full_plan

parameters.help_en:
The incremental backup policy. The value is in JSON format and contains the following fields:
start: the backup start time.
interval: the interval.
type: the unit of the interval.
days: the days of the week on which the backup is performed
parameters.help_zh:
增量备份策略。格式为JSON格式。包含以下字段：
start：备份开始时间
interval：间隔周期
type：间隔周期单位
days：周中执行日期
parameters.name: inc_plan

parameters.help_en:
The status of the policy. Valid values:
enabled: The policy is enabled.
disabled: The policy is disabled
parameters.help_zh:
策略状态。取值：
enabled：启用策略
disabled：已禁用策略
parameters.name: policy_status

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request. You can use this ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
